title: 语法 · 非谓语｜分词、补足与逻辑主语 · 60 句
description: 主动与被动分词、状语、感官和使役补足、with 结构及悬垂分词辨析。

items.zh: 站在帐篷旁唱歌的人是我们的厨师。
items.en: The person singing beside the tent is our cook.
answers: The person singing beside the tent is our cook.
items.notes: singing 主动修饰 person，相当于 who is singing。

items.zh: 所有希望参加夜游的游客都应携带外套。
items.en: Visitors wishing to join the night tour should bring a coat.
answers: Visitors wishing to join the night tour should bring a coat.
items.notes: wishing 表游客的主动意愿，不能用 wished。

items.zh: 流经村庄的小溪在下游汇入大河。
items.en: The stream flowing through the village joins a larger river downstream.
answers: The stream flowing through the village joins a larger river downstream.
items.notes: flowing 修饰 stream，主句动词为 joins。

items.zh: 这个俱乐部欢迎正在学习第二种语言的退休人士。
items.en: The club welcomes retired people learning a second language.
answers: The club welcomes retired people learning a second language.
items.notes: learning 为后置定语；retired 为已退休状态。

items.zh: 我喜欢那些探讨普通人生活的小说。
items.en: I enjoy novels exploring the lives of ordinary people.
answers: I enjoy novels exploring the lives of ordinary people.
items.notes: exploring 与 novels 为主动意义关系。

items.zh: 到达终点的选手会得到一条干毛巾。
items.en: Runners reaching the finish receive a dry towel.
answers: Runners reaching the finish receive a dry towel.
items.notes: reaching 修饰 runners，不作为主句谓语。

items.zh: 房价的上涨使新来的教师更难找到住处。
items.en: Rising house prices make accommodation harder to find for newly arrived teachers.
answers: Rising house prices make accommodation harder to find for newly arrived teachers.
items.notes: rising 是主动变化，不能用 raised 表自然上涨。

items.zh: 连接各村的班车只在集市日运行。
items.en: The shuttle linking the villages runs only on market days.
answers: The shuttle linking the villages runs only on market days.
items.notes: linking 作定语，runs 才是主句谓语。

items.zh: 正在接受采访的医生要求暂停片刻。
items.en: The doctor being interviewed asked for a short break.
answers: The doctor being interviewed asked for a short break.
items.notes: being interviewed 表被动且正在进行。

items.zh: 在山坡上觅食的鹿没有注意到我们。
items.en: The deer feeding on the hillside did not notice us.
answers: The deer feeding on the hillside did not notice us.
The deer feeding on the hillside didn't notice us.
items.notes: feeding 主动修饰 deer；定语可压缩关系从句。

items.zh: 用当地水果制作的果酱只在秋季出售。
items.en: Jam made from local fruit is sold only in autumn.
answers: Jam made from local fruit is sold only in autumn.
items.notes: made 为被动定语；is sold 为主句谓语。

items.zh: 这首献给朋友的诗直到多年后才发表。
items.en: The poem dedicated to a friend was published only years later.
answers: The poem dedicated to a friend was published only years later.
items.notes: dedicated to：献给；过去分词表被动关系。

items.zh: 受洪水影响的家庭可以申请临时住宿。
items.en: Families affected by the flood may request temporary accommodation.
answers: Families affected by the flood may request temporary accommodation.
items.notes: affected by 指受到影响，而非 affecting 主动影响别人。

items.zh: 我们听到的版本是由学生改编的。
items.en: The version we heard was adapted by students.
answers: The version we heard was adapted by students.
items.notes: was adapted 为谓语被动；we heard 是定语从句。

items.zh: 采摘过早的梨口感可能偏硬。
items.en: Pears picked too early may have a hard texture.
answers: Pears picked too early may have a hard texture.
items.notes: picked too early 后置修饰 pears。

items.zh: 我带回了一幅用炭笔画的肖像。
items.en: I brought back a portrait drawn in charcoal.
answers: I brought back a portrait drawn in charcoal.
items.notes: drawn 是 draw 的过去分词，不是 drawing。

items.zh: 为新手预留的泳道今天用于教学。
items.en: The lane reserved for beginners is used for lessons today.
answers: The lane reserved for beginners is used for lessons today.
items.notes: reserved 为定语，is used 为谓语，不能漏 is。

items.zh: 一段毫无变化地反复演奏的旋律可能失去吸引力。
items.en: A melody repeated without variation may lose its appeal.
answers: A melody repeated without variation may lose its appeal.
items.notes: repeated 为被动后置定语，修饰 melody；主句谓语是 may lose。

items.zh: 这家店出售已经修复的二手乐器。
items.en: The shop sells restored second-hand instruments.
answers: The shop sells restored second-hand instruments.
items.notes: restored 表已修复，与待修复不同。

items.zh: 没有及时冷藏的奶制品不能用于这道甜点。
items.en: Dairy products not refrigerated promptly cannot be used in this dessert.
answers: Dairy products not refrigerated promptly cannot be used in this dessert.
Dairy products not refrigerated promptly can't be used in this dessert.
items.notes: not 置于分词前，否定被动修饰语。

items.zh: 听到自己的曲子被演奏，他忍不住笑了。
items.en: Hearing his composition performed, he could not help smiling.
answers: Hearing his composition performed, he could not help smiling.
Hearing his composition performed, he couldn't help smiling.
items.notes: Hearing 的逻辑主语为 he；performed 补充 composition。

items.zh: 沿着河岸走，我们看到了水獭留下的痕迹。
items.en: Walking along the riverbank, we spotted signs of otters.
answers: Walking along the riverbank, we spotted signs of otters.
items.notes: walking 的执行者须与 we 一致，避免悬垂分词。

items.zh: 她把日记递给我，示意我看最后一页。
items.en: She handed me the diary, pointing to its final page.
answers: She handed me the diary, pointing to its final page.
items.notes: pointing 表伴随动作，主语仍是 she。

items.zh: 没有认出主办人，我直接走过了他身旁。
items.en: Not recognising the organiser, I walked straight past him.
answers: Not recognising the organiser, I walked straight past him.
items.notes: not doing 作原因状语，否定放在分词前。

items.zh: 考虑到父母行动不便，我们选了不用爬楼的餐厅。
items.en: Considering our parents' limited mobility, we chose a restaurant without stairs.
answers: Considering our parents' limited mobility, we chose a restaurant without stairs.
items.notes: considering 引出考虑因素；与主句决策有关。

items.zh: 她先核对了歌词，然后才加入合唱。
items.en: Having checked the lyrics, she joined the choir.
answers: Having checked the lyrics, she joined the choir.
items.notes: having done 表先于主句完成的动作，重点在先后结构。

items.zh: 游客挤满了街道，使居民很难推车通过。
items.en: Visitors filled the street, making it difficult for residents to push carts through.
answers: Visitors filled the street, making it difficult for residents to push carts through.
items.notes: making 表自然结果，逻辑原因是前句整体。

items.zh: 由于不知道路线变更，我们去了原来的集合点。
items.en: Not knowing about the route change, we went to the original meeting point.
answers: Not knowing about the route change, we went to the original meeting point.
items.notes: not knowing 表原因，主语与 we 一致。

items.zh: 他坐在岸边，看着孩子们放纸船。
items.en: He sat on the bank, watching the children launch paper boats.
answers: He sat on the bank, watching the children launch paper boats.
items.notes: watching 为伴随状语，不是另一个完整句子。

items.zh: 为了接近鸟巢，我们慢慢移动，尽量不发出声音。
items.en: We moved slowly towards the nest, trying to make no sound.
answers: We moved slowly towards the nest, trying to make no sound.
items.notes: trying 表伴随努力，to make 为 try 的补足。

items.zh: 被问到最喜欢哪段旅程时，她提到了夜间渡海。
items.en: Asked about her favourite journey, she mentioned a night crossing.
answers: Asked about her favourite journey, she mentioned a night crossing.
items.notes: asked 的承受者是 she，不能以 journey 为主语。

items.zh: 如果保存得当，这些种子能维持活性。
items.en: Stored properly, these seeds remain viable.
answers: Stored properly, these seeds remain viable.
items.notes: stored properly 压缩被动条件从句。

items.zh: 被观众的热情鼓舞，乐队加演了一首。
items.en: Encouraged by the audience, the band played an extra song.
answers: Encouraged by the audience, the band played an extra song.
items.notes: encouraged 表乐队受到鼓舞的原因。

items.zh: 这道菜配上米饭后，足够两个人吃。
items.en: Served with rice, the dish is enough for two.
answers: Served with rice, the dish is enough for two.
items.notes: served 与 dish 为被动关系。

items.zh: 与沿海地区相比，内陆的温差更大。
items.en: Compared with the coast, inland areas have greater temperature variation.
answers: Compared with the coast, inland areas have greater temperature variation.
items.notes: compared with 的比较对象需与主句主语同类。

items.zh: 第一次听来，这段旋律似乎很简单。
items.en: Heard for the first time, the melody seems simple.
answers: Heard for the first time, the melody seems simple.
items.notes: heard 的对象为 melody，保持逻辑主语一致。

items.zh: 除非有人邀请，否则他不愿进入讨论。
items.en: Unless invited, he prefers to stay out of the discussion.
answers: Unless invited, he prefers to stay out of the discussion.
items.notes: unless invited 省略 unless he is invited。

items.zh: 即使切成小块，这种肉仍需要慢炖。
items.en: Even cut into small pieces, this meat still needs slow cooking.
answers: Even cut into small pieces, this meat still needs slow cooking.
items.notes: even + 被动分词短语表让步。

items.zh: 被雾笼罩，岛上的灯塔几乎看不见。
items.en: Covered in mist, the island's lighthouse was barely visible.
answers: Covered in mist, the island's lighthouse was barely visible.
items.notes: covered 修饰主句主语 lighthouse，说明不可见的原因。

items.zh: 按年龄分组后，差异变得更容易理解。
items.en: Grouped by age, the results became easier to interpret.
answers: Grouped by age, the results became easier to interpret.
items.notes: grouped 指结果数据被分组，不指研究者。

items.zh: 我听见观众在走廊里轻声唱那首歌。
items.en: I heard the audience singing the song softly in the corridor.
answers: I heard the audience singing the song softly in the corridor.
items.notes: hear someone doing 强调听到正在发生的过程。

items.zh: 我们看着那只鸟从栏杆飞到了树上。
items.en: We watched the bird fly from the railing to the tree.
answers: We watched the bird fly from the railing to the tree.
items.notes: watch someone do 原形强调完整动作。

items.zh: 她发现自己的名字被拼错了。
items.en: She found her name misspelled.
answers: She found her name misspelled.
items.notes: find + 宾语 + 过去分词，表示发现被处理后的状态。

items.zh: 我感到脚下的地板在振动。
items.en: I felt the floor vibrating beneath my feet.
answers: I felt the floor vibrating beneath my feet.
items.notes: feel something doing 表正在发生的感受。

items.zh: 下雨时让窗户半开着是不安全的。
items.en: Leaving the window half open in the rain is unsafe.
answers: Leaving the window half open in the rain is unsafe.
items.notes: leave + 宾语 + 形容词作状态补足。

items.zh: 我们请人把鞋跟修好了。
items.en: We had the heels repaired.
answers: We had the heels repaired.
items.notes: have something done 表请别人处理，不是自己执行。

items.zh: 孩子们让老师在场边等了很久。
items.en: The children kept the teacher waiting at the edge of the field.
answers: The children kept the teacher waiting at the edge of the field.
items.notes: keep someone doing 表动作持续，不接 to wait。

items.zh: 她把声音放轻，以免吵醒婴儿。
items.en: She kept her voice low to avoid waking the baby.
answers: She kept her voice low to avoid waking the baby.
items.notes: keep + 宾语 + 形容词，low 补充 voice 状态。

items.zh: 我不愿让争吵毁掉这顿饭。
items.en: I do not want the meal ruined by an argument.
answers: I do not want the meal ruined by an argument.
I don't want the meal ruined by an argument.
items.notes: want + 宾语 + 过去分词，meal 是被毁掉的对象。

items.zh: 我们把空出来的房间称为“交换角”。
items.en: We called the spare room the exchange corner.
answers: We called the spare room the exchange corner.
items.notes: call + 宾语 + 名词，名词作宾语补足语。

items.zh: 孩子们都睡着后，家里终于安静了下来。
items.en: With the children asleep, the house was finally quiet.
answers: With the children asleep, the house was finally quiet.
items.notes: with + 名词 + 形容词表背景状态。

items.zh: 还有两位客人没到，我们暂时没有开饭。
items.en: With two guests still to arrive, we delayed the meal.
answers: With two guests still to arrive, we delayed the meal.
items.notes: with + 名词 + to do 表尚待发生的事。

items.zh: 风从背后吹来，骑车轻松了许多。
items.en: With the wind behind us, cycling felt much easier.
answers: With the wind behind us, cycling felt much easier.
items.notes: with + 名词 + 介词短语，描述背景位置。

items.zh: 所有灯都亮着，舞台看起来比平时大。
items.en: With every light on, the stage looked larger than usual.
answers: With every light on, the stage looked larger than usual.
items.notes: on 为状态副词，补充 light。

items.zh: 双手被购物袋占着，我没法拿钥匙。
items.en: With my hands full of shopping bags, I could not reach my keys.
answers: With my hands full of shopping bags, I could not reach my keys.
With my hands full of shopping bags, I couldn't reach my keys.
items.notes: with 结构允许其内部主语 hands 与主句 I 不同。

items.zh: 听完录音后，这段对话更容易理解了。
items.en: After we listened to the recording, the conversation was easier to understand.
answers: After we listened to the recording, the conversation was easier to understand.
items.notes: 保留 we，避免写 Listening ... the conversation 造成悬垂分词。

items.zh: 看着地图时，我忽然明白我们绕了多远。
items.en: Looking at the map, I realised how far we had gone around.
answers: Looking at the map, I realised how far we had gone around.
items.notes: Looking 的执行者与 I 相同；how far 从句为宾语。

items.zh: 从列车上望出去，我看到山顶积着雪。
items.en: Looking out from the train, I saw snow on the peaks.
answers: Looking out from the train, I saw snow on the peaks.
items.notes: 分词主语是观察者 I，不是 snow。

items.zh: 客人们一走，我们就开始收拾。
items.en: The guests having left, we began clearing up.
answers: The guests having left, we began clearing up.
items.notes: 独立主格结构具有自身主语 the guests，与 we 不同。

items.zh: 如果把散步时间算进去，整个行程需要三小时。
items.en: With walking time included, the whole outing takes three hours.
answers: With walking time included, the whole outing takes three hours.
items.notes: with + 名词 + 过去分词表被计入的条件。
